document.about: Pages 124–125 of a New Mexico Oil Conservation Division filing (public): a well-service invoice over two pages. Page 125 repeats the form's head and the items' header, and carries on the items: the last item's daily total carried over the break, two items, and a credit note under them. The form's tax box stands at each page's foot.

notes: Source: https://ocdimage.emnrd.nm.gov/Imaging/FileStore/santafe/cf/20251009/24683_10_09_2025_04_29_13.pdf (sha256 275bbae5e89e5cad2c26becabc09dbcd800c0ae01d87c94be89dcd6a65097940), pages 124 and 125. Made with pypdf: add those two pages to a PdfWriter, `remove_images(to_delete=ImageType.XOBJECT_IMAGES | ImageType.INLINE_IMAGES)` (raster images only: the default also strips vector drawings, the grid's rules and shading), `compress_content_streams()` on each page, `compress_identical_objects(remove_duplicates=True, remove_unreferenced=True)`, write. The images dropped are the letterhead's logo.

2026-11-28 (#640): the second page's items are read as rows (the rest of the page before's last item and a note under the items each a row of their own), the band's rows are no header, and the part carries on the first page's across the form's foot and head, set again at the same place.

checks.issue: Page 125's last item read as paragraphs.
The credit note under the items stays in the table, a row of its own.
